headline: Anthropic files for IPO as AI pricing wars intensify across industry
body: Anthropic has filed its S-1 registration statement with the SEC, signaling plans for a public offering at a moment when major AI vendors are slashing LLM prices by up to 80 percent. This pricing compression directly impacts healthcare organizations evaluating AI infrastructure for clinical documentation, diagnostic support, and EHR integration, as cost-per-inference becomes a primary decision factor. Healthcare AI deployments require sustained pricing predictability to justify board-level investments in these tools. The timing of Anthropic's IPO filing against aggressive competitive pricing raises questions about profitability and unit economics in healthcare AI vendor selection criteria. For healthcare consultants and health systems, this landscape shift means renegotiating terms with incumbent vendors and reassessing which AI companies can sustain operations in value-based care deployments.
